results.evidence: InviteRow: `isExistingMember = existingMemberEmails.has(...)` adds ' errored' class and renders inline text 'This email already belongs to a member...' in the shared InviteRow used by the settings dialog.
existingMemberEmails selector includes `user?.email` alongside member emails, so own email is flagged the same way.

canSubmit now returns false for existing-member emails, but no disabled reason was added ('Please fill out all fields' remains per author's own summary). The per-row 'Submit' button only checks `!isEmail(...)`, so it stays enabled for such a row (though inviteTeamMembers returns [] when !canSubmit).
Both the set entries and lookups use `.trim().toLowerCase()`, so ' Rose.Dawson@PostHog.com' matches.
`afterMount` and `showInviteModal` listener call `actions.ensureAllMembersLoaded()`; selector includes `user?.email` independent of members loading (`members ?? []`).

Check moved into `validate_target_email`, which runs during serializer validation of all rows before any save; this assumes the bulk view validates the whole list before creating (not shown, but the author states it and validation-before-save is the standard flow with is_valid then save).
`raise exceptions.ValidationError(..., code="already_member")` inside `validate_target_email` yields a field-level error on target_email with code already_member.
No change to error-tracking/exception capture anywhere in the patch; the author admits they did not find or change any such code. Frontend still may capture the API failure.
No handling of inviteTeamMembersFailure to reload members; only ensureAllMembersLoaded on mount/modal show.

result:
Invite rows now flag an existing member's email (or your own) before you submit. The backend rejects a batch containing one before it creates or emails any invite. I haven't run tests, typecheck or lint.

**Backend** (`posthog/api/organization_invite.py`)
- The existing-member check moved out of `OrganizationInviteSerializer.create()` and into `validate_target_email()`, so it uses the same case-insensitive email match as before.
- It now runs during validation of every row, before `serializer.save()`. A batch with an existing member in row three now fails with a 400 before any invite is created or emailed.
- It's an ordinary validation failure with code `already_member`. I did not find or change any error-tracking code, so I can't confirm the reporting stops. Before, the check ran inside `create()` after earlier rows had been saved.
- Your own email is covered because you're a member of the organization.
- I added `test_bulk_invite_with_existing_member_creates_no_invites` in `posthog/api/test/test_organization_invites.py`. It sends two new emails plus your own email in upper case, then expects a 400 and zero invites.

**Frontend** (both the onboarding step and the settings dialog use the same code)
- `inviteLogic.ts` now loads the organization's members when the logic mounts and when the modal opens. A new `existingMemberEmails` selector holds their emails plus your own, lowercased.
- `canSubmit` is false while any row matches one of those emails, so the submit and Continue buttons stay disabled.
- `InviteRow` in `InviteModal.tsx` marks the email input as errored and shows a message under it: "This email already belongs to a member of your organization. Remove it to continue."
- The member list is capped at 200 and may not have loaded yet. In those cases the row won't flag the email, and the server check still rejects it.
- I edited the kea type blocks in `inviteLogic.ts` by hand and did not run typegen.
- The Continue button's disabled reason in the onboarding step still says "Please fill out all fields" when an existing member's email is the blocker.
